purpose: Teach: 貴文/幸雄/十郎/洋一/博之/一夫/僕達/がわり

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人の貴文さんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to exchange letters with his friend Takafumi.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into a memory held at arm's length. Gentle pace, letting each detail land. Slight pause before the name, as if reaching back in time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、幸雄兄さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you, dear, when you were young, you used to play shogi with your brother Yukio, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, playful turnabout. Light lift on the question. Not challenging him — gently mirroring, with affection underneath. The knowing tone of a long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが十郎兄さんに敬意を持ってらした
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he held deep respect for his older brother Juro.
lines.style: Quieter now, more deliberate. The respect in his voice mirrors the respect he's describing. Slower cadence. A weight to it — not heavy, just present.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の洋一さんと釣りに行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear, when you were young, you went fishing with your friend Yoichi, didn't you?
lines.style: Matching his quieter tone but with warmth. A gentle insistence — she's following his lead now, not sparring. Affectionate, drawing him back to his own youth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが博之さんとお酒を酌み交わされた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he and Hiroyuki would share sake together.
lines.style: Even softer. The intimacy of that ritual — sharing sake — carried in the voice. Pause before the name. Breath settling. This is a moment he's holding.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お兄様の一夫さんと旅行されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear, when you were young, you took a trip with your older brother Kazuo, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle insistence continues. Her voice carries the weight of years — she remembers these things. A tender question, not impatient. Slight warmth on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「僕達は同じ世代だ」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he once said to us: 'We're of the same generation.'
lines.style: The quote lands gently. His voice carries what his father said — not reciting, but sharing a piece of him. Stillness. A man moved by a father's words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お茶が日がわり、つまりひがわりで楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear, when you were young, you enjoyed fresh tea every night, didn't you?
lines.style: Closes the circle with warmth. A small, simple pleasure she names for him. Her voice is tender, knowing, slightly playful in the trailing edge. The close of an old, beloved conversation.
